key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to poll kubectl for node status.

key.name: notify-node-changes
key.description: Notify when a node stops being Ready, and when it comes back.

key.name: notify-cluster-unreachable
key.summary: Notify when the cluster is unreachable
key.description: Notify when kubectl cannot reach the cluster for longer than the cluster delay.

key.name: notify-on-recovery
key.description: Also notify when a node comes back or the cluster becomes reachable again.

key.name: alert-node-for
key.description: How long a node must stay NotReady before it notifies.

key.name: alert-cluster-for
key.description: How long the cluster must stay unreachable before it notifies.

key.name: alert-keep-firing-for
key.description: How long an alert stays active after its condition clears, so a flapping node notifies once.

key.name: alert-repeat-interval
key.description: How often to notify again about a still-active alert. Zero notifies once.

key.name: alert-group-wait
key.description: How long to wait so alerts firing together arrive as one notification. Zero batches only those from the same poll.

key.name: alert-silence-until
key.description: Internal. Notifications are muted until this time; zero means not muted. Set from the panel menu.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Record poll and alert decisions in the system log. Off by default, since the log is shared with every other application. Credential material is redacted and raw kubectl output is never written.

key.name: alert-state
key.description: Internal. The serialized alert state machine, so a restart neither replays nor forgets alerts.

key.name: context
key.description: Context to monitor. Empty follows the current context.

key.name: kubectl-path
key.description: Full path to the kubectl binary. Empty looks it up on PATH.
